biggest_catch: The friend must open a checking account and deposit $500 within 60 days - without that deposit, you get nothing.
catches: Referrer must be 18+ and Diamond CU account holder; refer via share page, referral email, or social link.
Friend must be a new member and open a checking account, depositing a total of $500 within 60 days of opening.
$50 reward per valid referral; maximum 10 rewards ($500) per year.
Rewards fulfilled after the friend meets all requirements; can take up to 60 days for the reward to arrive.
No spam/self-referrals; one reward per valid referral; 18+ to participate.
Program rules subject to full Terms and Conditions; not an unlimited offer.
